title: Sacredly
summary: SA'CREDLY, adverb 1. Religiously; with due reverence as of something holy or consecrated to God; as, to observe the sabbath sacredly; the day is sacredly kept. 2. Inviolably; strictly; as, to observe

inlines.v: SA'CREDLY, adverb 1. Religiously; with due reverence as of something holy or consecrated to God; as, to observe the sabbath sacredly; the day is sacredly kept. 2. Inviolably; strictly; as, to observe one's word sacredly; a secret to be sacredly kept.
